name: trstctl dynamic-secret and secret-sync external substrate contract

database_backends.dynamic_secret.redis: official Redis container; native ACL user/auth/client-list/readback/revocation

cloud_dynamic_backends.dynamic_secret.aws_iam: full canonical SigV4 verification for IAM CreateUser/AttachUserPolicy/CreateAccessKey and delete sequence; generated access key signs an independently verified STS-scoped workload request before revocation and is rejected afterward
cloud_dynamic_backends.dynamic_secret.gcp_iam: Bearer-authenticated IAM service-account public-key upload/find/delete; substrate verifies a workload signature against the uploaded X.509 public key before revocation and rejects it afterward
cloud_dynamic_backends.dynamic_secret.azure_entra: Bearer-authenticated Microsoft Graph addPassword/removePassword; generated client secret authenticates against substrate
cloud_dynamic_backends.dynamic_secret.kubernetes: Bearer-authenticated ServiceAccount, RoleBinding and TokenRequest; generated token authenticates until ServiceAccount deletion

sync_targets.secret_sync.registry: exact configured bearer-token authorization, generic JSON CI write with base64 decoding, and independent value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.aws_secrets_manager: full canonical SigV4 verification for PutSecretValue/CreateSecret upsert, stable outbox-operation ClientRequestToken plus Idempotency-Key, forced crash after receiver commit, retry reconciliation, exactly one remote version, and decoded value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.gcp_secret_manager: Bearer secret-container create plus addVersion, stable Idempotency-Key propagation, forced crash after receiver commit, latest-version retry reconciliation, exactly one remote version, and decoded value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.azure_key_vault: Bearer Key Vault set-secret wire shape, stable Idempotency-Key propagation, forced crash after receiver commit, latest-version retry reconciliation, exactly one remote version, and decoded value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.github_actions: repository public-key GET returns a fresh X25519 key held by a separate libsodium-compatible receiver process; key-id-bound sealed-box PUT is authenticated/decrypted there and the independently recovered plaintext is compared with the source
sync_targets.secret_sync.gitlab_ci: PRIVATE-TOKEN variable update/create semantics and value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.vercel: Bearer project environment-variable create semantics and value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.generic_ci_json: exact configured bearer-token authorization, generic JSON CI write with base64 decoding, and independent value readback
sync_targets.secret_sync.kubernetes_secrets: Kubernetes GET/create Secret semantics and decoded data readback

security.credentials: native authorization is required; AWS requests require complete canonical SigV4 verification, GitHub requires authenticated sealed-box decryption, and generated material is checked through a separate auth/readback call
security.completion: dynamic passed requires issue + working credential + revoke; sync passed requires native write + independent readback, and each version-creating target must survive a forced crash after receiver commit by reconciling the retry to exactly one remote version
